description: List all WhatsApp notification messages sent for an assignment. The response includes the rendered template text split into `header`, `body` and `buttons` — exactly what the signer would see. In sandbox/stage, WhatsApp messages are simulated (no real delivery) and button URLs include access/verification codes you can use to simulate the signing flow. Treat returned signing links and verification codes as sensitive; never use them to sign for another person. Use it to troubleshoot WhatsApp delivery for one assignment.
name: assinafy_list_whatsapp_notifications
title: List WhatsApp notifications
